title: $L^2$-contraction of Shock Waves for KdV-Burgers Equation
summary: The KdV-Burgers equation is a canonical model describing the interplay between nonlinearity, viscosity and dispersion, and it admits viscous-dispersive shocks as traveling wave solutions. In this paper, we establish an $L^2$-contraction property for viscous-dispersive shocks under arbitrarily large perturbations, up to a time-dependent shift. This yields time-asymptotic stability and uniform estimates with respect to the strengths of viscosity and dispersion.
